newsitem.title: USA: Japan corrects remarks about Russia-Japan summit.
newsitem.headline: Japan corrects remarks about Russia-Japan summit.

text.p: A Japanese Foreign Ministry spokesman said remarks made by a Japanese government official earlier Friday that Russian President Boris Yeltsin promised to stop pointing missiles at China was wrong.
The government official, who briefed foreign reporters on a meeting between Yeltsin and Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto, had said Russia promised to cease targetting missiles at China and Japan.

"The official mentioned China by mistake. In the Yeltsin- Hashimoto summit, only Japan was mentioned and there was no mention of China in relation to the missile targets," the Foreign Ministry spokesman told Reuters.
A Russian spokesman earlier on Friday denied the remarks by the Japanese official which mentioned China.
